## Checklist

- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] My commits are signed off (DCO): `git commit -s` (`Signed-off-by:` present).
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Docs render correctly (links and Mermaid diagrams).
- [ ] If this touches `spec/`: it stays language-agnostic, normative, and implementable from the text alone.
- [ ] If this touches the implementation: it conforms to the spec and tests/lint pass (when code exists).
- [ ] I updated [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) under `[Unreleased]` if user-facing.
